053    /**
054     * GE has the unusual distinction of being an application with coordinates
055     * outside its own extents. It appears to only be a problem when lines cross
056     * the IDL
057     *
058     * @param pts2d the client points
059     */
060    public static void NormalizeGECoordsToGEExtents(double leftLongitude,
061            double rightLongitude,
062            ArrayList<Point2D> pts2d) {
063        try {
064            int j = 0;
065            double x = 0, y = 0;
066            Point2D pt2d = null;
067            int n = pts2d.size();
068            //for (j = 0; j < pts2d.size(); j++) 
069            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
070                pt2d = pts2d.get(j);
071                x = pt2d.getX();
072                y = pt2d.getY();
073                while (x < leftLongitude) {
074                    x += 360;
075                }
076                while (x > rightLongitude) {
077                    x -= 360;
078                }
079
080                pt2d = new Point2D.Double(x, y);
081                pts2d.set(j, pt2d);
082            }
083        } catch (Exception exc) {
084        }
085    }
086
087    /**
088     * GE recognizes coordinates in the range of -180 to +180
089     *
090     * @param pt2d
091     * @return
092     */
093    protected static Point2D NormalizeCoordToGECoord(Point2D pt2d) {
094        Point2D ptGeo = null;
095        try {
096            double x = pt2d.getX(), y = pt2d.getY();
097            while (x < -180) {
098                x += 360;
099            }
100            while (x > 180) {
101                x -= 360;
102            }
103
104            ptGeo = new Point2D.Double(x, y);
105        } catch (Exception exc) {
106        }
107        return ptGeo;
108    }

110    /**
111     * We have to ensure the bounding rectangle at least includes the symbol or
112     * there are problems rendering, especially when the symbol crosses the IDL
113     *
114     * @param controlPoints the client symbol anchor points
115     * @param bbox the original bounding box
116     * @return the modified bounding box
117     */
118    private static String getBoundingRectangle(String controlPoints,
119            String bbox) {
120        String bbox2 = "";
121        try {
122            //first get the minimum bounding rect for the geo coords
123            Double left = 0.0;
124            Double right = 0.0;
125            Double top = 0.0;
126            Double bottom = 0.0;
127
128            String[] coordinates = controlPoints.split(" ");
129            int len = coordinates.length;
130            int i = 0;
131            left = Double.MAX_VALUE;
132            right = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
133            top = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
134            bottom = Double.MAX_VALUE;
135            for (i = 0; i < len; i++) {
136                String[] coordPair = coordinates[i].split(",");
137                Double latitude = Double.valueOf(coordPair[1].trim());
138                Double longitude = Double.valueOf(coordPair[0].trim());
139                if (longitude < left) {
140                    left = longitude;
141                }
142                if (longitude > right) {
143                    right = longitude;
144                }
145                if (latitude > top) {
146                    top = latitude;
147                }
148                if (latitude < bottom) {
149                    bottom = latitude;
150                }
151            }
152            bbox2 = left.toString() + "," + bottom.toString() + "," + right.toString() + "," + top.toString();
153        } catch (Exception ex) {
154            System.out.println("Failed to create bounding rectangle in MultiPointHandler.getBoundingRect");
155        }
156        return bbox2;
157    }

159    /**
160     * need to use the symbol to get the upper left control point in order to
161     * produce a valid PointConverter
162     *
163     * @param geoCoords
164     * @return
165     */
166    private static Point2D getControlPoint(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
167        Point2D pt2d = null;
168        try {
169            double left = Double.MAX_VALUE;
170            double right = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
171            double top = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
172            double bottom = Double.MAX_VALUE;
173            Point2D ptTemp = null;
174            int n = geoCoords.size();
175            //for (int j = 0; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
176            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
177                ptTemp = geoCoords.get(j);
178                if (ptTemp.getX() < left) {
179                    left = ptTemp.getX();
180                }
181                if (ptTemp.getX() > right) {
182                    right = ptTemp.getX();
183                }
184                if (ptTemp.getY() > top) {
185                    top = ptTemp.getY();
186                }
187                if (ptTemp.getY() < bottom) {
188                    bottom = ptTemp.getY();
189                }
190            }
191            pt2d = new Point2D.Double(left, top);
192        } catch (Exception ex) {
193            System.out.println("Failed to create control point in MultiPointHandler.getControlPoint");
194        }
195        return pt2d;
196    }

198    /**
199     * Assumes a reference in which the north pole is on top.
200     *
201     * @param geoCoords the geographic coordinates
202     * @return the upper left corner of the MBR containing the geographic
203     * coordinates
204     */
205    static Point2D getGeoUL(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
206        Point2D ptGeo = null;
207        try {
208            int j = 0;
209            Point2D pt = null;
210            double left = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
211            double top = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
212            double right = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
213            double bottom = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
214            int n = geoCoords.size();
215            //for (j = 1; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
216            for (j = 1; j < n; j++) {
217                pt = geoCoords.get(j);
218                if (pt.getX() < left) {
219                    left = pt.getX();
220                }
221                if (pt.getX() > right) {
222                    right = pt.getX();
223                }
224                if (pt.getY() > top) {
225                    top = pt.getY();
226                }
227                if (pt.getY() < bottom) {
228                    bottom = pt.getY();
229                }
230            }
231            //if geoCoords crosses the IDL
232            if (right - left > 180) {
233                //There must be at least one x value on either side of +/-180. Also, there is at least
234                //one positive value to the left of +/-180 and negative x value to the right of +/-180.
235                //We are using the orientation with the north pole on top so we can keep
236                //the existing value for top. Then the left value will be the least positive x value
237                //left = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
238                left = 180;
239                //for (j = 1; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
240                n = geoCoords.size();
241                for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
242                    pt = geoCoords.get(j);
243                    if (pt.getX() > 0 && pt.getX() < left) {
244                        left = pt.getX();
245                    }
246                }
247            }
248            ptGeo = new Point2D.Double(left, top);
249        } catch (Exception ex) {
250            System.out.println("Failed to create control point in MultiPointHandler.getControlPoint");
251        }
252        return ptGeo;
253    }
254    static String getBboxFromCoords(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
255        //var ptGeo = null;
256        String bbox = null;
257        try {
258            int j = 0;
259            Point2D pt = null;
260            double left = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
261            double top = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
262            double right = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
263            double bottom = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
264            for (j = 1; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) {
265                pt = geoCoords.get(j);
266                if (pt.getX() < left) {
267                    left = pt.getX();
268                }
269                if (pt.getX() > right) {
270                    right = pt.getX();
271                }
272                if (pt.getY() > top) {
273                    top = pt.getY();
274                }
275                if (pt.getY() < bottom) {
276                    bottom = pt.getY();
277                }
278            }
279            //if geoCoords crosses the IDL
280            if (right - left > 180) {
281                //There must be at least one x value on either side of +/-180. Also, there is at least
282                //one positive value to the left of +/-180 and negative x value to the right of +/-180.
283                //We are using the orientation with the north pole on top so we can keep
284                //the existing value for top. Then the left value will be the least positive x value
285                //left = geoCoords[0].x;
286                left = 180;
287                right = -180;
288                for (j = 0; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) {
289                    pt = geoCoords.get(j);
290                    if (pt.getX() > 0 && pt.getX() < left) {
291                        left = pt.getX();
292                    }
293                    if (pt.getX() < 0 && pt.getX() > right) {
294                        right = pt.getX();
295                    }
296                }
297            }
298            //ptGeo = new Point2D(left, top);
299            bbox = Double.toString(left) + "," + Double.toString(bottom) + "," + Double.toString(right) + "," + Double.toString(top);
300        } catch (Exception ex) {
301            System.out.println("Failed to create control point in MultiPointHandler.getBboxFromCoords");
302        }
303        //return ptGeo;            
304        return bbox;
305    }

307    static boolean crossesIDL(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
308        boolean result = false;
309        Point2D pt2d = getControlPoint(geoCoords);
310        double left = pt2d.getX();
311        Point2D ptTemp = null;
312        int n = geoCoords.size();
313        //for (int j = 0; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
314        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
315            ptTemp = geoCoords.get(j);
316            if (Math.abs(ptTemp.getX() - left) > 180) {
317                return true;
318            }
319        }
320        return result;
321    }

413                id == 25330300 || //MSR

423                id == 25151205 || //Retain
424                id == 25341500 //Isolate
425        )
426        {

428        }
429        if(!useFillPattern){
430
431            if(
432                    id == 25151100 || //Limited Access Area //no longer needed with pattern fill
433                    id == 25172000 || //Weapons Free Zone //no longer needed with pattern fill
434                    id == 25271700 || //Biological Contaminated Area //no longer needed with pattern fill

441                    id == 25240303  //No Fire Area (NFA) - Circular //no longer needed with pattern fill
442            )
443                shouldClip = true;//not using fill pattern so clip to not draw more lines than we have to

445        if(!useDashArray){

461    /**
462     * Assumes bbox is of form left,bottom,right,top and it is currently only
463     * using the width to calculate a reasonable scale. If the original scale is
464     * within the max and min range it returns the original scale.
465     *
466     * @param bbox
467     * @param origScale
468     * @return
469     */
470    static double getReasonableScale(String bbox, double origScale) {
471        try {
472
473            if(!RendererSettings.getInstance().getAutoAdjustScale())
474                return origScale;
475
476            String[] bounds = bbox.split(",");
477            double left = Double.valueOf(bounds[0]);
478            double right = Double.valueOf(bounds[2]);
479            double top = Double.valueOf(bounds[3]);
480            double bottom = Double.valueOf(bounds[1]);
481
482            POINT2 ul = new POINT2(left, top);
483            POINT2 ur = new POINT2(right, top);
484
485            double widthInMeters;
486            if ((left == -180 && right == 180) || (left == 180 && right == -180))
487                widthInMeters = 40075017d / 2d; // Earth's circumference / 2
488            else
489                widthInMeters = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(ul, ur, null, null);
490
491            double maxWidthInPixels = Math.max(RendererSettings.getInstance().getDeviceWidth(), RendererSettings.getInstance().getDeviceHeight());
492            double minScale = widthInMeters / (maxWidthInPixels / RendererSettings.getInstance().getDeviceDPI() / GeoPixelConversion.INCHES_PER_METER);
493            if (origScale < minScale) {
494                return minScale;
495            }
496
497            double minWidthInPixels = Math.min(RendererSettings.getInstance().getDeviceWidth(), RendererSettings.getInstance().getDeviceHeight()) / 2.0;
498            double maxScale = widthInMeters / (minWidthInPixels / RendererSettings.getInstance().getDeviceDPI() / GeoPixelConversion.INCHES_PER_METER);
499            if (origScale > maxScale) {
500                return maxScale;
501            }
502        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
503        }
504        return origScale;
505    }

833            }

840            }
841            if (rect != null) {

843            }
844            if (jsonOutput != null) {
845                System.out.println(jsonOutput.toString());
846            }
847        }
848
849        ErrorLogger.LogMessage("MultiPointHandler", "RenderSymbol()", "exit RenderSymbol", Level.FINER);
850        return jsonOutput.toString();
851
852    }

1160    private static ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> ConvertPolylinePixelsToCoords(ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> polylines, IPointConversion ipc, Boolean normalize) {
1161        ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> newPolylines = new ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>();
1162
1163        double latitude = 0;
1164        double longitude = 0;
1165        ArrayList<Point2D> newLine = null;
1166        try {
1167            for (ArrayList<Point2D> line : polylines) {
1168                newLine = new ArrayList<Point2D>();
1169                for (Point2D pt : line) {
1170                    Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(pt);
1171
1172                    if (normalize) {
1173                        geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
1174                    }
1175
1176                    latitude = geoCoord.getY();
1177                    longitude = geoCoord.getX();
1178                    newLine.add(new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude));
1179                }
1180                newPolylines.add(newLine);
1181            }
1182        } catch (Exception exc) {
1183            System.out.println(exc.getMessage());
1184            exc.printStackTrace();
1185        }
1186        return newPolylines;
1187    }

1208    public static String RenderSymbol2D(String id,
1209            String name,
1210            String description,

1219        StringBuilder jsonOutput = new StringBuilder();

1221

1224        ArrayList<POINT2> tgPoints = null;
1225
1226        String[] coordinates = controlPoints.split(" ");
1227        TGLight tgl = new TGLight();
1228        ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes = new ArrayList<ShapeInfo>();
1229        ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers = new ArrayList<ShapeInfo>();
1230        ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords = new ArrayList<Point2D>();
1231        int len = coordinates.length;
1232        IPointConversion ipc = null;
1233
1234        //check for required points & parameters
1235        String symbolIsValid = canRenderMultiPoint(symbolCode, symbolModifiers, len);
1236        if (!symbolIsValid.equals("true")) {
1237            String ErrorOutput = "";
1238            ErrorOutput += ("{\"type\":\"error\",\"error\":\"There was an error creating the MilStdSymbol " + symbolCode + " - ID: " + id + " - ");
1239            ErrorOutput += symbolIsValid; //reason for error
1240            ErrorOutput += ("\"}");
1241            ErrorLogger.LogMessage("MultiPointHandler", "RenderSymbol2D", symbolIsValid, Level.WARNING);
1242            return ErrorOutput;
1243        }
1244
1245        Double left = 0.0;
1246        Double right = 0.0;
1247        Double top = 0.0;
1248        Double bottom = 0.0;
1249        if (bbox != null && bbox.equals("") == false) {
1250            String[] bounds = bbox.split(",");
1251
1252            left = Double.valueOf(bounds[0]).doubleValue();
1253            right = Double.valueOf(bounds[2]).doubleValue();
1254            top = Double.valueOf(bounds[3]).doubleValue();
1255            bottom = Double.valueOf(bounds[1]).doubleValue();
1256
1257            ipc = new PointConversion(pixelWidth, pixelHeight, top, left, bottom, right);
1258        } else {
1259            System.out.println("Bad bbox value: " + bbox);
1260            System.out.println("bbox is viewable area of the map.  Passed in the format of a string \"lowerLeftX,lowerLeftY,upperRightX,upperRightY.\" example: \"-50.4,23.6,-42.2,24.2\"");
1261            return "ERROR - Bad bbox value: " + bbox;
1262        }
1263        //end section
1264
1265        //get coordinates
1266        if (MSLookup.getInstance().getMSLInfo(symbolCode).getDrawRule() != DrawRules.AREA10) // AREA10 can support infinite points
1267            len = Math.min(len, MSLookup.getInstance().getMSLInfo(symbolCode).getMaxPointCount());
1268        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
1269            String[] coordPair = coordinates[i].split(",");
1270            Double latitude = Double.valueOf(coordPair[1].trim()).doubleValue();
1271            Double longitude = Double.valueOf(coordPair[0].trim()).doubleValue();
1272            geoCoords.add(new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude));
1273        }
1274
1275        try {
1276            MilStdSymbol mSymbol = new MilStdSymbol(symbolCode, null, geoCoords, null);
1277
1278            if (format == WebRenderer.OUTPUT_FORMAT_GEOSVG){
1279                // Use dash array and hatch pattern fill for SVG output
1280                symbolAttributes.put(MilStdAttributes.UseDashArray, "true");
1281                symbolAttributes.put(MilStdAttributes.UsePatternFill, "true");
1282            }
1283
1284            if (symbolModifiers != null && symbolModifiers.equals("") == false) {
1285                populateModifiers(symbolModifiers, symbolAttributes, mSymbol);
1286            } else {
1287                mSymbol.setFillColor(null);
1288            }
1289
1290            //build clipping bounds
1291            Point2D temp = null;
1292            int leftX;
1293            int topY;
1294            int bottomY;
1295            int rightX;
1296            int width;
1297            int height;
1298            boolean normalize = false;
1299//            if(Math.abs(right-left)>180)
1300//            {
1301//                ((PointConversion)ipc).set_normalize(true);                
1302//                normalize=true;
1303//            }
1304//            else      
1305//            {
1306//                ((PointConversion)ipc).set_normalize(false);
1307//            }
1308
1309            if (ShouldClipSymbol(symbolCode, mSymbol.getUseDashArray(), mSymbol.getUseFillPattern())  || crossesIDL(geoCoords))
1310            {
1311                Point2D lt=new Point2D.Double(left,top);
1312                //temp = ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(left, top));
1313                temp = ipc.GeoToPixels(lt);
1314                leftX = (int) temp.getX();
1315                topY = (int) temp.getY();
1316
1317                Point2D rb=new Point2D.Double(right,bottom);
1318                //temp = ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(right, bottom));
1319                temp = ipc.GeoToPixels(rb);
1320                bottomY = (int) temp.getY();
1321                rightX = (int) temp.getX();
1322                //////////////////
1323
1324                width = (int) Math.abs(rightX - leftX);
1325                height = (int) Math.abs(bottomY - topY);
1326
1327                rect = new Rectangle(leftX, topY, width, height);
1328            }
1329
1330            //new interface
1331            //IMultiPointRenderer mpr = MultiPointRenderer.getInstance();
1332            Rectangle clipBounds = getOverscanClipBounds(rect, ipc);
1333            clsRenderer.renderWithPolylines(mSymbol, ipc, clipBounds);
1334            shapes = mSymbol.getSymbolShapes();
1335            modifiers = mSymbol.getModifierShapes();
1336
1337            //boolean normalize = false;
1338
1339            if (format == WebRenderer.OUTPUT_FORMAT_JSON) {
1340                jsonOutput.append("{\"type\":\"symbol\",");
1341                //jsonContent = JSONize(shapes, modifiers, ipc, normalize);
1342                jsonOutput.append(jsonContent);
1343                jsonOutput.append("}");
1344            } else if (format == WebRenderer.OUTPUT_FORMAT_KML) {
1345                Color textColor = mSymbol.getTextColor();
1346                if(textColor==null)
1347                    textColor=mSymbol.getLineColor();
1348
1349                jsonContent = KMLize(id, name, description, symbolCode, shapes, modifiers, ipc, normalize, textColor, mSymbol.getWasClipped(), mSymbol.isTextScaleSensitive(), mSymbol.isSymbolScaleSensitive());
1350                jsonOutput.append(jsonContent);
1351            } else if (format == WebRenderer.OUTPUT_FORMAT_GEOJSON) {
1352                jsonOutput.append("{\"type\":\"FeatureCollection\",\"features\":");
1353                jsonContent = GeoJSONize(shapes, modifiers, ipc, normalize, mSymbol.getTextColor(), mSymbol.getTextBackgroundColor());
1354                jsonOutput.append(jsonContent);
1355
1356                //moving meta data properties to the last feature with no coords as feature collection doesn't allow properties
1357                jsonOutput.replace(jsonOutput.toString().length()-1,jsonOutput.toString().length(),"" );
1358                if (jsonContent.length() > 2)
1359                    jsonOutput.append(",");
1360                jsonOutput.append("{\"type\": \"Feature\",\"geometry\": { \"type\": \"Polygon\",\"coordinates\": [ ]}");
1361
1362                jsonOutput.append(",\"properties\":{\"id\":\"");
1363                jsonOutput.append(id);
1364                jsonOutput.append("\",\"name\":\"");
1365                jsonOutput.append(name);
1366                jsonOutput.append("\",\"description\":\"");
1367                jsonOutput.append(description);
1368                jsonOutput.append("\",\"symbolID\":\"");
1369                jsonOutput.append(symbolCode);
1370                jsonOutput.append("\",\"wasClipped\":\"");
1371                jsonOutput.append(String.valueOf(mSymbol.getWasClipped()));
1372                jsonOutput.append("\",\"textScaleSensitive\":\"");
1373                jsonOutput.append(String.valueOf(mSymbol.isTextScaleSensitive()));
1374                jsonOutput.append("\",\"symbolScaleSensitive\":\"");
1375                jsonOutput.append(String.valueOf(mSymbol.isSymbolScaleSensitive()));
1376                //jsonOutput.append("\"}}");
1377
1378                jsonOutput.append("\"}}]}");
1379
1380            } else if (format == WebRenderer.OUTPUT_FORMAT_GEOSVG) {
1381                String textColor = mSymbol.getTextColor() != null ? RendererUtilities.colorToHexString(mSymbol.getTextColor(), false) : "";
1382                String backgroundColor = mSymbol.getTextBackgroundColor() != null ? RendererUtilities.colorToHexString(mSymbol.getTextBackgroundColor(), false) : "";
1383                //returns an svg with a geoTL and geoBR value to use to place the canvas on the map
1384                jsonContent = MultiPointHandlerSVG.GeoSVGize(id, name, description, symbolCode, shapes, modifiers, ipc, normalize, textColor, backgroundColor, mSymbol.get_WasClipped());
1385                jsonOutput.append(jsonContent);
1386            }
1387        } catch (Exception exc) {
1388            jsonOutput = new StringBuilder();
1389            jsonOutput.append("{\"type\":\"error\",\"error\":\"There was an error creating the MilStdSymbol " + symbolCode + ": " + "- ");
1390            jsonOutput.append(exc.getMessage() + " - ");
1391            jsonOutput.append(ErrorLogger.getStackTrace(exc));
1392            jsonOutput.append("\"}");
1393        }
1394
1395        boolean debug = false;
1396        if (debug == true) {
1397            System.out.println("Symbol Code: " + symbolCode);
1398            System.out.println("BBOX: " + bbox);
1399            if (controlPoints != null) {
1400                System.out.println("Geo Points: " + controlPoints);
1401            }
1402            if (tgl != null && tgl.get_Pixels() != null)//pixels != null
1403            {
1404                //System.out.println("Pixel: " + pixels.toString());
1405                System.out.println("Pixel: " + tgl.get_Pixels().toString());
1406            }
1407            if (bbox != null) {
1408                System.out.println("geo bounds: " + bbox);
1409            }
1410            if (rect != null) {
1411                System.out.println("pixel bounds: " + rect.toString());
1412            }
1413            if (jsonOutput != null) {
1414                System.out.println(jsonOutput.toString());
1415            }
1416        }
1417
1418        return jsonOutput.toString();
1419
1420    }

1422    static Rectangle getOverscanClipBounds(Rectangle rect, IPointConversion ipc) {
1423        if (rect == null)
1424            return null;
1425        double maxWidth = Math.abs(ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(180, 0)).getX() - ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(0, 0)).getX());
1426        double maxHeight = Math.abs(ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(0, 90)).getY() - ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(0, -90)).getY());
1427        double overScanScale = RendererSettings.getInstance().getOverscanScale();
1428        if (rect.width * overScanScale > maxWidth) {
1429            overScanScale = maxWidth / rect.width;
1430        }
1431        if (rect.height * overScanScale > maxHeight) {
1432            overScanScale = maxHeight / rect.height;
1433        }
1434        return new Rectangle((int) (rect.x - (rect.width * (overScanScale - 1)) / 2), (int) (rect.y - (rect.height * (overScanScale - 1)) / 2), (int) (rect.width * overScanScale), (int) (rect.height * overScanScale));
1435    }

1565    private static SymbolInfo MilStdSymbolToSymbolInfo(MilStdSymbol symbol) {
1566        SymbolInfo si = null;
1567
1568        ArrayList<TextInfo> tiList = new ArrayList<TextInfo>();
1569        ArrayList<LineInfo> liList = new ArrayList<LineInfo>();
1570
1571        TextInfo tiTemp = null;
1572        LineInfo liTemp = null;
1573        ShapeInfo siTemp = null;
1574
1575        ArrayList<ShapeInfo> lines = symbol.getSymbolShapes();
1576        ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers = symbol.getModifierShapes();
1577
1578        int lineCount = lines.size();
1579        int modifierCount = modifiers.size();
1580        for (int i = 0; i < lineCount; i++) {
1581            siTemp = lines.get(i);
1582            if (siTemp.getPolylines() != null) {
1583                liTemp = new LineInfo();
1584                liTemp.setFillColor(siTemp.getFillColor());
1585                liTemp.setLineColor(siTemp.getLineColor());
1586                liTemp.setPolylines(siTemp.getPolylines());
1587                liTemp.setStroke(siTemp.getStroke());
1588                liList.add(liTemp);
1589            }
1590        }
1591
1592        for (int j = 0; j < modifierCount; j++) {
1593            tiTemp = new TextInfo();
1594            siTemp = modifiers.get(j);
1595            if (siTemp.getModifierString() != null) {
1596                tiTemp.setModifierString(siTemp.getModifierString());
1597                tiTemp.setModifierStringPosition(siTemp.getModifierPosition());
1598                tiTemp.setModifierStringAngle(siTemp.getModifierAngle());
1599                tiList.add(tiTemp);
1600            }
1601        }
1602        si = new SymbolInfo(tiList, liList);
1603        return si;
1604    }

1606    /**
1607     * Populates a symbol with the modifiers from a JSON string. This function
1608     * will overwrite any previously populated modifier data.
1609     *
1610     *
1611     *
1612     * @param symbol An existing MilStdSymbol
1613     * @return
1614     */
1615    static boolean populateModifiers(Map<String,String> saModifiers, Map<String,String> saAttributes, MilStdSymbol symbol) {
1616        Map<String,String> modifiers = new HashMap<>();
1617        Map<String,String> attributes = new HashMap<>();
1618        saAttributes.putAll(attributes);
1619
1620        // Stores array graphic modifiers for MilStdSymbol;
1621        ArrayList<Double> altitudes = null;
1622        ArrayList<Double> azimuths = null;
1623        ArrayList<Double> distances = null;
1624
1625        // Stores colors for symbol.
1626        String fillColor = null;
1627        String lineColor = null;
1628        String textColor = null;
1629        String textBackgroundColor = null;
1630
1631        int lineWidth = 0;
1632        String altMode = null;
1633        boolean useDashArray = symbol.getUseDashArray();
1634        boolean usePatternFill = symbol.getUseFillPattern();
1635        int patternFillType = 0;
1636        boolean hideOptionalLabels = false;
1637        DistanceUnit distanceUnit = null;
1638        DistanceUnit altitudeUnit = null;
1639        int pixelSize = 100;
1640        boolean keepUnitRatio = true;
1641        double patternScale = RendererSettings.getInstance().getPatternScale();
1642
1643        try {
1644
1645            // The following attirubtes are labels.  All of them
1646            // are strings and can be added on the creation of the
1647            // MilStdSymbol by adding to a Map and passing in the
1648            // modifiers parameter.
1649            if (saModifiers != null) {
1650                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.C_QUANTITY)) {
1651                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.C_QUANTITY, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.C_QUANTITY)));
1652                }
1653
1654                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1)) {
1655                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1)));
1656                }
1657
1658                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2)) {
1659                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2)));
1660                }
1661
1662                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3)) {
1663                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3)));
1664                }
1665
1666                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.N_HOSTILE)) {
1667                    if (saModifiers.get(Modifiers.N_HOSTILE) == null) {
1668                        modifiers.put(Modifiers.N_HOSTILE, "");
1669                    } else {
1670                        modifiers.put(Modifiers.N_HOSTILE, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.N_HOSTILE)));
1671                    }
1672                }
1673
1674                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.Q_DIRECTION_OF_MOVEMENT)) {
1675                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.Q_DIRECTION_OF_MOVEMENT, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.Q_DIRECTION_OF_MOVEMENT)));
1676                }
1677
1678                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1)) {
1679                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1)));
1680                }
1681
1682                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2)) {
1683                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2)));
1684                }
1685
1686                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.V_EQUIP_TYPE)) {
1687                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.V_EQUIP_TYPE, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.V_EQUIP_TYPE)));
1688                }
1689
1690                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.AS_COUNTRY)) {
1691                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.AS_COUNTRY, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.AS_COUNTRY)));
1692                } else if (SymbolID.getCountryCode(symbol.getSymbolID()) > 0 && !GENCLookup.getInstance().get3CharCode(SymbolID.getCountryCode(symbol.getSymbolID())).equals("")) {
1693                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.AS_COUNTRY, GENCLookup.getInstance().get3CharCode(SymbolID.getCountryCode(symbol.getSymbolID())));
1694                }
1695
1696                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.AP_TARGET_NUMBER)) {
1697                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.AP_TARGET_NUMBER, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.AP_TARGET_NUMBER)));
1698                }
1699
1700                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.W_DTG_1)) {
1701                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.W_DTG_1, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.W_DTG_1)));
1702                }
1703
1704                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.W1_DTG_2)) {
1705                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.W1_DTG_2, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.W1_DTG_2)));
1706                }
1707
1708                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.Y_LOCATION)) {
1709                    modifiers.put(Modifiers.Y_LOCATION, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.Y_LOCATION)));
1710                }
1711
1712                //Required multipoint modifier arrays
1713                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH)) {
1714                    altitudes = new ArrayList<Double>();
1715                    String[] arrAltitudes = String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH)).split(",");
1716                    for (String x : arrAltitudes) {
1717                        if (x.equals("") != true) {
1718                            altitudes.add(Double.parseDouble(x));
1719                        }
1720                    }
1721                }
1722
1723                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.AM_DISTANCE)) {
1724                    distances = new ArrayList<Double>();
1725                    String[] arrDistances = String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.AM_DISTANCE)).split(",");
1726                    for (String am : arrDistances) {
1727                        if (am.equals("") != true) {
1728                            distances.add(Double.parseDouble(am));
1729                        }
1730                    }
1731                }
1732
1733                if (saModifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.AN_AZIMUTH)) {
1734                    azimuths = new ArrayList<Double>();
1735                    String[] arrAzimuths = String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(Modifiers.AN_AZIMUTH)).split(",");;
1736                    for (String an : arrAzimuths) {
1737                        if (an.equals("") != true) {
1738                            azimuths.add(Double.parseDouble(an));
1739                        }
1740                    }
1741                }
1742            }
1743            if (saAttributes != null) {
1744                // These properties are ints, not labels, they are colors.//////////////////
1745                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.FillColor)) {
1746                    fillColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.FillColor);
1747                }
1748
1749                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.LineColor)) {
1750                    lineColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.LineColor);
1751                }
1752
1753                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.LineWidth)) {
1754                    lineWidth = Integer.parseInt(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.LineWidth));
1755                }
1756                
1757                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.TextColor)) {
1758                    textColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.TextColor);
1759                }
1760                
1761                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.TextBackgroundColor)) {
1762                    textBackgroundColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.TextBackgroundColor);
1763                }
1764
1765                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeMode)) {
1766                    altMode = saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeMode);
1767                }
1768
1769                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.UseDashArray)) {
1770                    useDashArray = Boolean.parseBoolean(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.UseDashArray));
1771                }
1772
1773                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.UsePatternFill)) {
1774                    usePatternFill = Boolean.parseBoolean(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.UsePatternFill));
1775                }
1776
1777                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.PatternFillType)) {
1778                    patternFillType = Integer.parseInt((saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.PatternFillType)));
1779                }
1780
1781                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.HideOptionalLabels)) {
1782                    hideOptionalLabels = Boolean.parseBoolean(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.HideOptionalLabels));
1783                }
1784
1785                if(saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeUnits)) {
1786                    altitudeUnit = DistanceUnit.parse(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeUnits));
1787                }
1788
1789                if(saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.DistanceUnits)) {
1790                    distanceUnit = DistanceUnit.parse(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.DistanceUnits));
1791                }
1792
1793                if(saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.PixelSize)) {
1794                    pixelSize = Integer.parseInt(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.PixelSize));
1795                    symbol.setUnitSize(pixelSize);
1796                }
1797
1798                if (saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.KeepUnitRatio)) {
1799                    keepUnitRatio = Boolean.parseBoolean(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.KeepUnitRatio));
1800                    symbol.setKeepUnitRatio(keepUnitRatio);
1801                }
1802
1803                if(saAttributes.containsKey(MilStdAttributes.PatternScale)) {
1804                    patternScale = Double.parseDouble(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.PatternScale));
1805                }
1806            }
1807
1808            symbol.setModifierMap(modifiers);
1809
1810            if (fillColor != null && fillColor.equals("") == false) {
1811                symbol.setFillColor(RendererUtilities.getColorFromHexString(fillColor));
1812            } 
1813
1814            if (lineColor != null && lineColor.equals("") == false) {
1815                symbol.setLineColor(RendererUtilities.getColorFromHexString(lineColor));
1816                symbol.setTextColor(RendererUtilities.getColorFromHexString(lineColor));
1817            }
1818            else if(symbol.getLineColor()==null)
1819                symbol.setLineColor(Color.black);
1820
1821            if (lineWidth > 0) {
1822                symbol.setLineWidth(lineWidth);
1823            }
1824            
1825            if (textColor != null && textColor.equals("") == false) {
1826                symbol.setTextColor(RendererUtilities.getColorFromHexString(textColor));
1827            } else if(symbol.getTextColor()==null)
1828                symbol.setTextColor(Color.black);
1829                
1830            if (textBackgroundColor != null && textBackgroundColor.equals("") == false) {
1831                symbol.setTextBackgroundColor(RendererUtilities.getColorFromHexString(textBackgroundColor));
1832            }
1833
1834            if (altMode != null) {
1835                symbol.setAltitudeMode(altMode);
1836            }
1837
1838            symbol.setUseDashArray(useDashArray);
1839            symbol.setUseFillPattern(usePatternFill);
1840            symbol.setHideOptionalLabels(hideOptionalLabels);
1841            symbol.setAltitudeUnit(altitudeUnit);
1842            symbol.setDistanceUnit(distanceUnit);
1843            symbol.setPatternScale(patternScale);
1844
1845            // Check grpahic modifiers variables.  If we set earlier, populate
1846            // the fields, otherwise, ignore.
1847            if (altitudes != null) {
1848                symbol.setModifiers_AM_AN_X(Modifiers.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH, altitudes);
1849            }
1850            if (distances != null) {
1851                symbol.setModifiers_AM_AN_X(Modifiers.AM_DISTANCE, distances);
1852            }
1853
1854            if (azimuths != null) {
1855                symbol.setModifiers_AM_AN_X(Modifiers.AN_AZIMUTH, azimuths);
1856            }
1857
1858            //Check if sector range fan has required min range
1859            if (SymbolUtilities.getBasicSymbolID(symbol.getSymbolID()).equals("25242200")) {
1860                if (symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(Modifiers.AN_AZIMUTH) != null
1861                        && symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(Modifiers.AM_DISTANCE) != null) {
1862                    int anCount = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(Modifiers.AN_AZIMUTH).size();
1863                    int amCount = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(Modifiers.AM_DISTANCE).size();
1864                    ArrayList<Double> am = null;
1865                    if (amCount < ((anCount / 2) + 1)) {
1866                        am = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(Modifiers.AM_DISTANCE);
1867                        if (am.get(0) != 0.0) {
1868                            am.add(0, 0.0);
1869                        }
1870                    }
1871                }
1872            }
1873        } catch (Exception exc2) {
1874            Log.e("MPH.populateModifiers", exc2.getMessage(), exc2);
1875        }
1876        return true;
1877
1878    }

1880    private static String KMLize(String id,
1881                                 String name,
1882                                 String description,
1883                                 String symbolCode,
1884                                 ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes,
1885                                 ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers,
1886                                 IPointConversion ipc,
1887                                 boolean normalize,
1888                                 Color textColor,
1889                                 boolean wasClipped,
1890                                 int textScaleSensitive,
1891                                 int symbolScaleSensitive) {
1892        java.lang.StringBuilder kml = new java.lang.StringBuilder();
1893        ShapeInfo tempModifier = null;
1894        String cdataStart = "<![CDATA[";
1895        String cdataEnd = "]]>";
1896        int len = shapes.size();
1897        kml.append("<Folder id=\"").append(id).append("\">");
1898        kml.append("<name>").append(cdataStart).append(name).append(cdataEnd).append("</name>");
1899        kml.append("<visibility>1</visibility>");
1900        kml.append("<description>").append(cdataStart).append(description).append(cdataEnd).append("</description>");
1901        kml.append("<ExtendedData>");
1902        kml.append("<Data name=\"symbolID\"><value>").append(symbolCode).append("</value></Data>");
1903        kml.append("<Data name=\"wasClipped\"><value>").append(wasClipped).append("</value></Data>");
1904        kml.append("<Data name=\"textScaleSensitive\"><value>").append(textScaleSensitive).append("</value></Data>");
1905        kml.append("<Data name=\"symbolScaleSensitive\"><value>").append(symbolScaleSensitive).append("</value></Data>");
1906        kml.append("</ExtendedData>");
1907        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
1908            String shapesToAdd = ShapeToKMLString(shapes.get(i), ipc, normalize);
1909            kml.append(shapesToAdd);
1910        }
1911
1912        int len2 = modifiers.size();
1913
1914        for (int j = 0; j < len2; j++) {
1915
1916            tempModifier = modifiers.get(j);
1917
1918            //if(geMap)//if using google earth
1919            //assume kml text is going to be centered
1920            //AdjustModifierPointToCenter(tempModifier);
1921
1922            String labelsToAdd = LabelToKMLString(tempModifier, ipc, normalize, textColor);
1923            kml.append(labelsToAdd);
1924        }
1925
1926        kml.append("</Folder>");
1927        return kml.toString();
1928    }

1940    private static String JSONize(ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes, ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers, IPointConversion ipc, Boolean geMap, boolean normalize) {
1941        String polygons = "";
1942        String lines = "";
1943        String labels = "";
1944        String jstr = "";
1945        ShapeInfo tempModifier = null;
1946
1947        int len = shapes.size();
1948        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
1949            if (jstr.length() > 0) {
1950                jstr += ",";
1951            }
1952            String shapesToAdd = ShapeToJSONString(shapes.get(i), ipc, geMap, normalize);
1953            if (shapesToAdd.length() > 0) {
1954                if (shapesToAdd.startsWith("line", 2)) {
1955                    if (lines.length() > 0) {
1956                        lines += ",";
1957                    }
1958
1959                    lines += shapesToAdd;
1960                } else if (shapesToAdd.startsWith("polygon", 2)) {
1961                    if (polygons.length() > 0) {
1962                        polygons += ",";
1963                    }
1964
1965                    polygons += shapesToAdd;
1966                }
1967            }
1968        }
1969
1970        jstr += "\"polygons\": [" + polygons + "],"
1971                + "\"lines\": [" + lines + "],";
1972        int len2 = modifiers.size();
1973        labels = "";
1974        for (int j = 0; j < len2; j++) {
1975            tempModifier = modifiers.get(j);
1976            if (geMap) {
1977                AdjustModifierPointToCenter(tempModifier);
1978            }
1979            String labelsToAdd = LabelToJSONString(tempModifier, ipc, normalize);
1980            if (labelsToAdd.length() > 0) {
1981                if (labels.length() > 0) {
1982                    labels += ",";
1983                }
1984
1985                labels += labelsToAdd;
1986
1987            }
1988        }
1989        jstr += "\"labels\": [" + labels + "]";
1990        return jstr;
1991    }

1993    static Color getIdealTextBackgroundColor(Color fgColor) {
1994        //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("SymbolDraw","getIdealtextBGColor", "in function", Level.SEVERE);
1995        try {
1996            //an array of three elements containing the
1997            //hue, saturation, and brightness (in that order),
1998            //of the color with the indicated red, green, and blue components/
1999            float hsbvals[] = new float[3];
2000
2001            if (fgColor != null) {/*
2002                 Color.RGBtoHSB(fgColor.getRed(), fgColor.getGreen(), fgColor.getBlue(), hsbvals);
2003
2004                 if(hsbvals != null)
2005                 {
2006                 //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("SymbolDraw","getIdealtextBGColor", "length: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals.length));
2007                 //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("SymbolDraw","getIdealtextBGColor", "H: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals[0]) + " S: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals[1]) + " B: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals[2]),Level.SEVERE);
2008                 if(hsbvals[2] > 0.6)
2009                 return Color.BLACK;
2010                 else
2011                 return Color.WHITE;
2012                 }*/
2013
2014                int nThreshold = RendererSettings.getInstance().getTextBackgroundAutoColorThreshold();//160;
2015                int bgDelta = (int) ((fgColor.getRed() * 0.299) + (fgColor.getGreen() * 0.587) + (fgColor.getBlue() * 0.114));
2016                //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("bgDelta: " + String.valueOf(255-bgDelta));
2017                //if less than threshold, black, otherwise white.
2018                //return (255 - bgDelta < nThreshold) ? Color.BLACK : Color.WHITE;//new Color(0, 0, 0, fgColor.getAlpha())
2019                return (255 - bgDelta < nThreshold) ? new Color(0, 0, 0, fgColor.getAlpha()) : new Color(255, 255, 255, fgColor.getAlpha());
2020            }
2021        } catch (Exception exc) {
2022            ErrorLogger.LogException("MultiPointHandler", "getIdealTextBackgroundColor", exc);
2023        }
2024        return Color.WHITE;
2025    }

2116    private static String ShapeToGeoJSONString(ShapeInfo shapeInfo, IPointConversion ipc, boolean normalize) {
2117        StringBuilder JSONed = new StringBuilder();
2118        StringBuilder properties = new StringBuilder();
2119        StringBuilder geometry = new StringBuilder();
2120        String geometryType = null;
2121        String sda = null;
2122        /*
2123         NOTE: Google Earth / KML colors are backwards.
2124         They are ordered Alpha,Blue,Green,Red, not Red,Green,Blue,Aplha like the rest of the world
2125         * */
2126        Color lineColor = shapeInfo.getLineColor();
2127        Color fillColor = shapeInfo.getFillColor();
2128
2129        if (shapeInfo.getShapeType() == ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL || fillColor != null || shapeInfo.getPatternFillImage() != null) {
2130            geometryType = "\"Polygon\"";
2131        } else //if(shapeInfo.getShapeType() == ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE)
2132        {
2133            geometryType = "\"MultiLineString\"";
2134        }
2135
2136        BasicStroke stroke = null;
2137        stroke = shapeInfo.getStroke();
2138        int lineWidth = 4;
2139
2140        if (stroke != null) {
2141            lineWidth = (int) stroke.getLineWidth();
2142            //lineWidth++;
2143            //System.out.println("lineWidth: " + String.valueOf(lineWidth));
2144        }
2145
2146        //generate JSON properties for feature
2147        properties.append("\"properties\":{");
2148        properties.append("\"label\":\"\",");
2149        if (lineColor != null) {
2150            properties.append("\"strokeColor\":\"" + RendererUtilities.colorToHexString(lineColor, false) + "\",");
2151            properties.append("\"lineOpacity\":" + String.valueOf(lineColor.getAlpha() / 255f) + ",");
2152        }
2153        if (fillColor != null) {
2154            properties.append("\"fillColor\":\"" + RendererUtilities.colorToHexString(fillColor, false) + "\",");
2155            properties.append("\"fillOpacity\":" + String.valueOf(fillColor.getAlpha() / 255f) + ",");
2156        }
2157        if (shapeInfo.getPatternFillImage() != null) {
2158            properties.append("\"fillPattern\":\"" + bitmapToString(shapeInfo.getPatternFillImage()) + "\",");
2159        }
2160        if(stroke.getDashArray() != null)
2161        {
2162            float[] arrSDA = stroke.getDashArray();
2163            sda = "[";
2164            sda += String.valueOf(arrSDA[0]);
2165            if(arrSDA.length > 1)
2166            {
2167                for(int i = 1; i < arrSDA.length; i++)
2168                {
2169                    sda = sda + ", " + String.valueOf(arrSDA[i]);
2170                }
2171            }
2172            sda += "]";
2173            sda = "\"strokeDasharray\":" + sda + ",";
2174            properties.append(sda);
2175        }
2176
2177        int lineCap = stroke.getEndCap();
2178        properties.append("\"lineCap\":" + lineCap + ",");
2179
2180        String strokeWidth = String.valueOf(lineWidth);
2181        properties.append("\"strokeWidth\":" + strokeWidth + ",");
2182        properties.append("\"strokeWeight\":" + strokeWidth + "");
2183        properties.append("},");
2184
2185
2186        properties.append("\"style\":{");
2187        if (lineColor != null) {
2188            properties.append("\"stroke\":\"" + RendererUtilities.colorToHexString(lineColor, false) + "\",");
2189            properties.append("\"line-opacity\":" + String.valueOf(lineColor.getAlpha() / 255f) + ",");
2190        }
2191        if (fillColor != null) {
2192            properties.append("\"fill\":\"" + RendererUtilities.colorToHexString(fillColor, false) + "\",");
2193            properties.append("\"fill-opacity\":" + String.valueOf(fillColor.getAlpha() / 255f) + ",");
2194        }
2195        if(stroke.getDashArray() != null)
2196        {
2197            float[] da = stroke.getDashArray();
2198            sda = String.valueOf(da[0]);
2199            if(da.length > 1)
2200            {
2201                for(int i = 1; i < da.length; i++)
2202                {
2203                    sda = sda + " " + String.valueOf(da[i]);
2204                }
2205            }
2206            sda = "\"stroke-dasharray\":\"" + sda + "\",";
2207            properties.append(sda);
2208            sda = null;
2209        }
2210
2211        if(lineCap == BasicStroke.CAP_SQUARE)
2212            properties.append("\"stroke-linecap\":\"square\",");
2213        else if(lineCap == BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND)
2214            properties.append("\"stroke-linecap\":\"round\",");
2215        else if(lineCap == BasicStroke.CAP_BUTT)
2216            properties.append("\"stroke-linecap\":\"butt\",");
2217
2218        strokeWidth = String.valueOf(lineWidth);
2219        properties.append("\"stroke-width\":" + strokeWidth);
2220        properties.append("}");
2221
2222
2223        //generate JSON geometry for feature
2224        geometry.append("\"geometry\":{\"type\":");
2225        geometry.append(geometryType);
2226        geometry.append(",\"coordinates\":[");
2227
2228        ArrayList shapesArray = shapeInfo.getPolylines();
2229
2230        for (int i = 0; i < shapesArray.size(); i++) {
2231            ArrayList pointList = (ArrayList) shapesArray.get(i);
2232
2233            normalize = normalizePoints(pointList, ipc);
2234
2235            geometry.append("[");
2236
2237            //System.out.println("Pixel Coords:");
2238            for (int j = 0; j < pointList.size(); j++) {
2239                Point2D coord = (Point2D) pointList.get(j);
2240                Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2241                //M. Deutch 9-27-11
2242                if (normalize) {
2243                    geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
2244                }
2245                double latitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getY() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2246                double longitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getX() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2247
2248                //fix for fill crossing DTL
2249                if (normalize && fillColor != null) {
2250                    if (longitude > 0) {
2251                        longitude -= 360;
2252                    }
2253                }
2254
2255                //diagnostic M. Deutch 10-18-11
2256                //set the point as geo so that the 
2257                //coord.setLocation(longitude, latitude);
2258                coord = new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude);
2259                pointList.set(j, coord);
2260                //end section
2261
2262                geometry.append("[");
2263                geometry.append(longitude);
2264                geometry.append(",");
2265                geometry.append(latitude);
2266                geometry.append("]");
2267
2268                if (j < (pointList.size() - 1)) {
2269                    geometry.append(",");
2270                }
2271            }
2272
2273            geometry.append("]");
2274
2275            if (i < (shapesArray.size() - 1)) {
2276                geometry.append(",");
2277            }
2278        }
2279        geometry.append("]}");
2280
2281        JSONed.append("{\"type\":\"Feature\",");
2282        JSONed.append(properties.toString());
2283        JSONed.append(",");
2284        JSONed.append(geometry.toString());
2285        JSONed.append("}");
2286
2287        return JSONed.toString();
2288    }

2340    protected static String bitmapToString(Bitmap bitmap) {
2341        final int COMPRESSION_QUALITY = 100;
2342        String encodedImage;
2343        ByteArrayOutputStream byteArrayBitmapStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
2344        bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, COMPRESSION_QUALITY,
2345                byteArrayBitmapStream);
2346        byte[] b = byteArrayBitmapStream.toByteArray();
2347        encodedImage = Base64.encodeToString(b, Base64.DEFAULT);
2348        return "data:image/png;base64," + encodedImage;
2349    }

2351    private static String GeoJSONize(ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes, ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers, IPointConversion ipc, boolean normalize, Color textColor, Color textBackgroundColor) {
2352
2353        String jstr = "";
2354        ShapeInfo tempModifier = null;
2355        StringBuilder fc = new StringBuilder();//JSON feature collection
2356
2357        fc.append("[");
2358
2359        int len = shapes.size();
2360        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
2361
2362            String shapesToAdd = ShapeToGeoJSONString(shapes.get(i), ipc, normalize);
2363            if (shapesToAdd.length() > 0) {
2364                fc.append(shapesToAdd);
2365                if (i < len - 1) {
2366                    fc.append(",");
2367                }
2368            }
2369        }
2370
2371        int len2 = modifiers.size();
2372
2373        for (int j = 0; j < len2; j++) {
2374            tempModifier = modifiers.get(j);
2375
2376            String modifiersToAdd = null;
2377            if(modifiers.get(j).getModifierImage() != null) {
2378                modifiersToAdd = ImageToGeoJSONString(tempModifier, ipc, normalize);
2379            } else {
2380                modifiersToAdd = LabelToGeoJSONString(tempModifier, ipc, normalize, textColor, textBackgroundColor);
2381            }
2382            if (modifiersToAdd.length() > 0) {
2383                if (fc.length() > 1)
2384                    fc.append(",");
2385                fc.append(modifiersToAdd);
2386            }
2387        }
2388        fc.append("]");
2389        String GeoJSON = fc.toString();
2390        return GeoJSON;
2391    }

2429    static Boolean normalizePoints(ArrayList<Point2D.Double> shape, IPointConversion ipc) {
2430        ArrayList geoCoords = new ArrayList();
2431        int n = shape.size();
2432        //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
2433        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
2434            Point2D coord = shape.get(j);
2435            Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2436            geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
2437            double latitude = geoCoord.getY();
2438            double longitude = geoCoord.getX();
2439            Point2D pt2d = new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude);
2440            geoCoords.add(pt2d);
2441        }
2442        Boolean normalize = crossesIDL(geoCoords);
2443        return normalize;
2444    }

2464    private static String ShapeToKMLString(ShapeInfo shapeInfo,
2465                                           IPointConversion ipc,
2466                                           boolean normalize) {
2467        java.lang.StringBuilder kml = new java.lang.StringBuilder();
2468        Color lineColor = null;
2469        Color fillColor = null;
2470        String googleLineColor = null;
2471        String googleFillColor = null;
2472        BasicStroke stroke = null;
2473        int lineWidth = 4;
2474
2475        kml.append("<Placemark>");
2476        kml.append("<Style>");
2477
2478        lineColor = shapeInfo.getLineColor();
2479        if (lineColor != null) {
2480            googleLineColor = Integer.toHexString(shapeInfo.getLineColor().toARGB());
2481
2482            stroke = shapeInfo.getStroke();
2483
2484            if (stroke != null) {
2485                lineWidth = (int) stroke.getLineWidth();
2486            }
2487
2488            googleLineColor = JavaRendererUtilities.ARGBtoABGR(googleLineColor);
2489
2490            kml.append("<LineStyle>");
2491            kml.append("<color>" + googleLineColor + "</color>");
2492            kml.append("<colorMode>normal</colorMode>");
2493            kml.append("<width>" + String.valueOf(lineWidth) + "</width>");
2494            kml.append("</LineStyle>");
2495        }
2496
2497        fillColor = shapeInfo.getFillColor();
2498        Bitmap fillPattern = shapeInfo.getPatternFillImage();
2499        if (fillColor != null || fillPattern != null) {
2500            kml.append("<PolyStyle>");
2501
2502            if (fillColor != null) {
2503                googleFillColor = Integer.toHexString(shapeInfo.getFillColor().toARGB());
2504                googleFillColor = JavaRendererUtilities.ARGBtoABGR(googleFillColor);
2505                kml.append("<color>" + googleFillColor + "</color>");
2506                kml.append("<colorMode>normal</colorMode>");
2507            }
2508            if (fillPattern != null){
2509                kml.append("<shader>" + bitmapToString(fillPattern) + "</shader>");
2510            }
2511
2512            kml.append("<fill>1</fill>");
2513            if (lineColor != null) {
2514                kml.append("<outline>1</outline>");
2515            } else {
2516                kml.append("<outline>0</outline>");
2517            }
2518            kml.append("</PolyStyle>");
2519        }
2520
2521        kml.append("</Style>");
2522
2523        ArrayList shapesArray = shapeInfo.getPolylines();
2524        int len = shapesArray.size();
2525        kml.append("<MultiGeometry>");
2526
2527        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
2528            ArrayList shape = (ArrayList) shapesArray.get(i);
2529            normalize = normalizePoints(shape, ipc);
2530            if (lineColor != null && fillColor == null) {
2531                kml.append("<LineString>");
2532                kml.append("<tessellate>1</tessellate>");
2533                kml.append("<altitudeMode>clampToGround</altitudeMode>");
2534                kml.append("<coordinates>");
2535                int n = shape.size();
2536                //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
2537                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
2538                    Point2D coord = (Point2D) shape.get(j);
2539                    Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2540                    if (normalize) {
2541                        geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
2542                    }
2543
2544                    double latitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getY() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2545                    double longitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getX() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2546
2547                    kml.append(longitude);
2548                    kml.append(",");
2549                    kml.append(latitude);
2550                    if(j<shape.size()-1)
2551                        kml.append(" ");
2552                }
2553
2554                kml.append("</coordinates>");
2555                kml.append("</LineString>");
2556            }
2557
2558            if (fillColor != null) {
2559
2560                if (i == 0) {
2561                    kml.append("<Polygon>");
2562                }
2563                //kml.append("<outerBoundaryIs>");
2564                if (i == 1 && len > 1) {
2565                    kml.append("<innerBoundaryIs>");
2566                } else {
2567                    kml.append("<outerBoundaryIs>");
2568                }
2569                kml.append("<LinearRing>");
2570                kml.append("<altitudeMode>clampToGround</altitudeMode>");
2571                kml.append("<tessellate>1</tessellate>");
2572                kml.append("<coordinates>");
2573
2574                int n = shape.size();
2575                //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
2576                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
2577                    Point2D coord = (Point2D) shape.get(j);
2578                    Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2579
2580                    double latitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getY() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2581                    double longitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getX() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2582
2583                    //fix for fill crossing DTL
2584                    if (normalize) {
2585                        if (longitude > 0) {
2586                            longitude -= 360;
2587                        }
2588                    }
2589
2590                    kml.append(longitude);
2591                    kml.append(",");
2592                    kml.append(latitude);
2593                    if(j<shape.size()-1)
2594                        kml.append(" ");
2595                }
2596
2597                kml.append("</coordinates>");
2598                kml.append("</LinearRing>");
2599                if (i == 1 && len > 1) {
2600                    kml.append("</innerBoundaryIs>");
2601                } else {
2602                    kml.append("</outerBoundaryIs>");
2603                }
2604                if (i == len - 1) {
2605                    kml.append("</Polygon>");
2606                }
2607            }
2608        }
2609
2610        kml.append("</MultiGeometry>");
2611        kml.append("</Placemark>");
2612
2613        return kml.toString();
2614    }

2932    public static String canRenderMultiPoint(String symbolID, Map<String,String> modifiers, int numPoints) {
2933        try {
2934            String basicID = SymbolUtilities.getBasicSymbolID(symbolID);
2935            MSInfo info = MSLookup.getInstance().getMSLInfo(symbolID);
2936
2937            if (info == null) {
2938                if (SymbolID.getVersion(symbolID) >= SymbolID.Version_2525E) {
2939                    return"Basic ID: " + basicID + " not recognized in version E (15)";
2940                } else {
2941                    return "Basic ID: " + basicID + " not recognized in version D (11)";
2942                }
2943            }
2944
2945            int drawRule = info.getDrawRule();
2946
2947            if (drawRule == DrawRules.DONOTDRAW) {
2948                return "Basic ID: " + basicID + " has no draw rule";
2949            } else if (!SymbolUtilities.isMultiPoint(symbolID)) {
2950                return "Basic ID: " + basicID + " is not a multipoint symbol";
2951            } else if (numPoints < info.getMinPointCount()) {
2952                return "Basic ID: " + basicID + " requires a minimum of " + String.valueOf(info.getMinPointCount()) + " points. " + String.valueOf(numPoints) + " are present.";
2953            }
2954
2955            //now check for required modifiers
2956            ArrayList<Double> AM = new ArrayList();
2957            ArrayList<Double> AN = new ArrayList();
2958            if (modifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.AM_DISTANCE)) {
2959                String[] amArray = modifiers.get(Modifiers.AM_DISTANCE).split(",");
2960                for (String str : amArray) {
2961                    if (!str.equals("")) {
2962                        AM.add(Double.parseDouble(str));
2963                    }
2964                }
2965            }
2966            if (modifiers.containsKey(Modifiers.AN_AZIMUTH)) {
2967                String[] anArray = modifiers.get(Modifiers.AN_AZIMUTH).split(",");
2968                for (String str : anArray) {
2969                    if (!str.equals("")) {
2970                        AN.add(Double.parseDouble(str));
2971                    }
2972                }
2973            }
2974
2975            return hasRequiredModifiers(symbolID, drawRule, AM, AN);
2976        } catch (Exception exc) {
2977            ErrorLogger.LogException("MultiPointHandler", "canRenderMultiPoint", exc);
2978            return "false: " + exc.getMessage();
2979        }
2980    }

2982    static private String hasRequiredModifiers(String symbolID, int drawRule, ArrayList<Double> AM, ArrayList<Double> AN) {
2983
2984        String message = symbolID;
2985        try {
2986            if (drawRule > 700) {
2987                if (drawRule == DrawRules.CIRCULAR1)
2988                {
2989                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
2990                        return "true";
2991                    } else {
2992                        message += " requires a modifiers object that has 1 distance/AM value.";
2993                        return message;
2994                    }
2995                } else if (drawRule == DrawRules.RECTANGULAR2)
2996                {
2997                    if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 2
2998                            && AN != null && AN.size() >= 1) {
2999                        return "true";
3000                    } else {
3001                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 2 distance/AM values and 1 azimuth/AN value.");
3002                        return message;
3003                    }
3004                } else if (drawRule == DrawRules.ARC1)
3005                {
3006                    if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 1
3007                            && AN != null && AN.size() >= 2) {
3008                        return "true";
3009                    } else {
3010                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 2 distance/AM values and 2 azimuth/AN values per sector.  The first sector can have just one AM value although it is recommended to always use 2 values for each sector.");
3011                        return message;
3012                    }
3013                } else if (drawRule == DrawRules.CIRCULAR2)
3014                {
3015                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
3016                        return "true";
3017                    } else {
3018                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has at least 1 distance/AM value");
3019                        return message;
3020                    }
3021                } else if (drawRule == DrawRules.RECTANGULAR1)
3022                {
3023                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
3024                        return "true";
3025                    } else {
3026                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 1 distance/AM value.");
3027                        return message;
3028                    }
3029                } else if (drawRule == DrawRules.ELLIPSE1)
3030                {
3031                    if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 2
3032                            && AN != null && AN.size() >= 1) {
3033                        return "true";
3034                    } else {
3035                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 2 distance/AM values and 1 azimuth/AN value.");
3036                        return message;
3037                    }
3038                }
3039                else if (drawRule == DrawRules.RECTANGULAR3)
3040                {
3041                    if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 1) {
3042                        return "true";
3043                    } else {
3044                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 1 distance/AM value.");
3045                        return message;
3046                    }
3047                } else {
3048                    //should never get here
3049                    return "true";
3050                }
3051            } else if (drawRule == DrawRules.POINT17) {
3052                if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 2
3053                        && AN != null && AN.size() >= 1) {
3054                    return "true";
3055                } else {
3056                    message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 2 distance/AM values and 1 azimuth/AN value.");
3057                    return message;
3058                }
3059            } else if (drawRule == DrawRules.POINT18) {
3060                if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 2
3061                        && AN != null && AN.size() >= 2) {
3062                    return "true";
3063                } else {
3064                    message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 2 distance/AM values and 2 azimuth/AN values.");
3065                    return message;
3066                }
3067            } else if (drawRule == DrawRules.CORRIDOR1) {
3068                if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
3069                    return "true";
3070                } else {
3071                    message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 1 distance/AM value.");
3072                    return message;
3073                }
3074            } else {
3075                //no required parameters
3076                return "true";
3077            }
3078        } catch (Exception exc) {
3079            ErrorLogger.LogException("MultiPointHandler", "hasRequiredModifiers", exc);
3080            return "true";
3081        }
3082    }

3589                jsonContent = GeoJSONize(shapes, modifiers, ipc, normalize, mSymbol.getTextColor(), mSymbol.getTextBackgroundColor());
3590                jsonOutput.append(jsonContent);
3591
3592                //moving meta data properties to the last feature with no coords as feature collection doesn't allow properties
3593                jsonOutput.replace(jsonOutput.toString().length()-1,jsonOutput.toString().length(),"" );
3594                if (jsonContent.length() > 2)
3595                    jsonOutput.append(",");
3596                jsonOutput.append("{\"type\": \"Feature\",\"geometry\": { \"type\": \"Polygon\",\"coordinates\": [ ]}");
3597
3598                jsonOutput.append(",\"properties\":{\"id\":\"");
3599                jsonOutput.append(id);
3600                jsonOutput.append("\",\"name\":\"");
3601                jsonOutput.append(name);
3602                jsonOutput.append("\",\"description\":\"");
3603                jsonOutput.append(description);
3604                jsonOutput.append("\",\"symbolID\":\"");
3605                jsonOutput.append(symbolCode);
3606                jsonOutput.append("\",\"wasClipped\":\"");
3607                jsonOutput.append(String.valueOf(mSymbol.getWasClipped()));
3608                jsonOutput.append("\",\"textScaleSensitive\":\"");
3609                jsonOutput.append(String.valueOf(mSymbol.isTextScaleSensitive()));
3610                jsonOutput.append("\",\"symbolScaleSensitive\":\"");
3611                jsonOutput.append(String.valueOf(mSymbol.isSymbolScaleSensitive()));
3612                //jsonOutput.append("\"}}");
3613
3614                jsonOutput.append("\"}}]}");
3615            } else if (format == WebRenderer.OUTPUT_FORMAT_GEOSVG) {
3616                String textColor = mSymbol.getTextColor() != null ? RendererUtilities.colorToHexString(mSymbol.getTextColor(), false) : "";
3617                String backgroundColor = mSymbol.getTextBackgroundColor() != null ? RendererUtilities.colorToHexString(mSymbol.getTextBackgroundColor(), false) : "";
3618                //returns an svg with a geoTL and geoBR value to use to place the canvas on the map
3619                jsonContent = MultiPointHandlerSVG.GeoSVGize(id, name, description, symbolCode, shapes, modifiers, ipc, normalize, textColor, backgroundColor, mSymbol.get_WasClipped());
3620                jsonOutput.append(jsonContent);
3621            }
3622        } catch (Exception exc) {
3623            String st = JavaRendererUtilities.getStackTrace(exc);
3624            jsonOutput = new StringBuilder();
3625            jsonOutput.append("{\"type\":\"error\",\"error\":\"There was an error creating the MilStdSymbol " + symbolCode + ": " + "- ");
3626            jsonOutput.append(exc.getMessage() + " - ");
3627            jsonOutput.append(st);
3628            jsonOutput.append("\"}");
3629
3630            ErrorLogger.LogException("MultiPointHandler", "RenderBasicShape", exc);
3631        }
3632
3633        boolean debug = false;
3634        if (debug == true) {
3635            System.out.println("Symbol Code: " + symbolCode);
3636            System.out.println("Scale: " + scale);
3637            System.out.println("BBOX: " + bbox);
3638            if (controlPoints != null) {
3639                System.out.println("Geo Points: " + controlPoints);
3640            }
3641            if (bbox != null) {
3642                System.out.println("geo bounds: " + bbox);
3643            }
3644            if (rect != null) {
3645                System.out.println("pixel bounds: " + rect.toString());
3646            }
3647            if (jsonOutput != null) {
3648                System.out.println(jsonOutput.toString());
3649            }
3650        }
3651
3652        ErrorLogger.LogMessage("MultiPointHandler", "RenderBasicShape()", "exit RenderBasicShape", Level.FINER);
3653        return jsonOutput.toString();
3654
3655    }
3656}
